decision.observation: The farmer is still beside the pink tree trunk on the road's south verge at 2:50 pm, with a bush blocking the southwest. He has barely moved in the last two steps.
decision.hypothesis: The tree trunk plus bush wedge him in on the south verge. Going up onto the open asphalt and then west along the road should clear the obstacle and lead toward town.
decision.memory: Stuck point: pink tree trunk and bush at the west end of the bus-road's south verge. Approach westward travel on the asphalt itself.
